fields.postcondition: the parameter collection contains an Input SqlDbType.Structured SqlParameter whose Value is null for null or empty collections or the corresponding IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord> sequence
fields.response: normalize parameterName to start with '@', create a SqlParameter with SqlDbType.Structured, TypeName set to sqlTypeName, and Direction = ParameterDirection.Input, assign Value = null when the input collection is null or empty (Count == 0), convert non-empty model or ShardKey collections via Mapper.ToSqlDataRecord / KeyedModelToSqlDataRecord / ShardKeysToSqlDataRecord, and pass non-collection IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord> sequences directly without eager enumeration
fields.subject: SqlParameterCollectionExtensions.AddSqlTableValuedParameter
fields.trigger: AddSqlTableValuedParameter is invoked on an IParameterCollection with a parameter name, SQL Server user-defined table type name, and row data
